rules.answer: Techtonic 2026 is a CS tech fest at MCC on 25 Sep 2026.

rules.question_hint: What time is registration and reporting?
rules.answer: Report by 8:30 AM on 25 Sep. Starts at 9:30 AM.

rules.question_hint: Where and when is the inauguration ceremony?
rules.answer: Inauguration at 9:30 AM in Anderson Hall at MCC.

rules.question_hint: What documents and dress code are required?
rules.answer: Bring your college ID & Bonafide. Formal attire.
Events: PPT, WebCraft, Debug, ADZAP, Quiz, Collage.

rules.question_hint: Tell me about Catalyst Paper Presentation.
rules.answer: Catalyst: PPT for 2 members. 8 min talk, 2 min Q&A.

rules.question_hint: What are the rules for Web Craft Web Designing?
rules.answer: Web Craft: 2 members. HTML & CSS only. No web access.

rules.question_hint: What are the rules for Breakpoint Debugging?
rules.answer: Breakpoint: C & Python debug for 2, 50 mins. No phones.

rules.question_hint: Tell me about Brand Storm ADZAP.
rules.answer: Brand Storm: ADZAP for 5. Topic on spot, 5 mins.

rules.question_hint: What are the rounds in the Synapse Quiz?
rules.answer: Synapse: Quiz for 2. Written, Buzzer & Rapid.

rules.question_hint: How do I submit for Pixelora Digital Collage?
rules.answer: Pixelora: Collage for 2. Email entry by 23 Sep.

rules.question_hint: How can I contact the organizers or view the website?
rules.answer: Site: techtonic- 2026.vercel. app. Mail CS dept.
